summary: Iter185 — Tested the new ZXing live-barcode scanner mode on ShipmentDonorPage. Found and FIXED a critical compile-blocker: @zxing/browser was added to package.json but its required peer dependency @zxing/library@^0.22.0 was NOT installed, so the entire frontend bundle failed to compile with 8x 'Module not found: Cannot resolve @zxing/library' errors and the donor page was completely unusable (visible 'Compiled with problems' overlay over the UI). Installed @zxing/library@^0.22.0 via yarn (with --ignore-engines for node 20 vs 22 mismatch on a transient peer), restarted frontend, then re-ran Playwright UI test: ALL UI checks PASS. Mode switcher renders, barcode is default selected, <video> element renders inside ship-donor-scan-barcode-pane, manual switching photo↔barcode works correctly (barcode pane removed in photo mode, dropzone+submit visible; pane re-mounts when switching back), no React hook-order errors, 0 relevant console errors, waybill button still functional after closing the scanner. Backend regression: full pytest test_iter183_scanner_waybill.py 9/9 PASS including the /scan-item ?isbn=9780140329513 endpoint.

integration_issues.issue: When BrowserMultiFormatReader.listVideoInputDevices() returns 0 devices (or a single device with empty deviceId), the code at ShipmentDonorPage.jsx:219-220 silently returns (`if (!deviceId || !active) return;`) without firing the expected 'Camera not available — switch to photo mode' toast or auto-flipping to photo mode. In our headless Playwright run, this manifested as a black <video> pane stuck in barcode mode with the green ZXing overlay but no stream and no user-facing feedback — the toast was NOT shown and mode did NOT flip. The toast only fires when the outer try/catch catches an exception (e.g., listVideoInputDevices throws). Severity: MINOR — the fallback works for the 'permission denied / throw' case; only the 'empty devices array' edge case lacks feedback. Suggested fix: change to `if (!deviceId) { toast.error('Camera not available — switch to photo mode'); setScanMode('photo'); return; }`.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Improve graceful fallback in ShipmentDonorPage.jsx ~line 219-220: when listVideoInputDevices returns 0 devices (or first device has empty deviceId), explicitly toast.error('Camera not available — switch to photo mode') and setScanMode('photo') instead of the current silent `return;`. Today the toast only fires in the outer catch when listVideoInputDevices itself throws.

(Already fixed by tester) Future main-agent task: when adding any third-party React/JS library that lists peer dependencies (like @zxing/browser → @zxing/library), install the peer too. The package.json should declare both, otherwise webpack compile fails.
critical_code_review_comments: ShipmentDonorPage.jsx:206-262 — useEffect is correctly placed BEFORE the early loading/error returns (line 264, 267), preserving hook order across renders. Confirmed at runtime: 0 React 'Rendered more/fewer hooks' errors during full open→switch→close cycle.

ShipmentDonorPage.jsx:256-261 cleanup is correct: marks active=false, stops controls, nulls the ref, and clears barcodeText. Effect re-runs cleanly when scanMode toggles. Verified by switching barcode→photo→barcode multiple times with no console errors and no orphan media tracks.

ShipmentDonorPage.jsx:229-240 — ISBN vs UPC routing is sound: /^(978|979)\d{10}$/ for ISBN, /^\d{8,14}$/ for UPC/EAN. Uses URLSearchParams to build the query string and passes X-Shipment-Edit-Token in headers — consistent with the iter183/184 backend contract.

CRITICAL DEPENDENCY GAP (now resolved): @zxing/browser declares @zxing/library@^0.22.0 as a *peer* dependency, not a regular dep. The original commit added only @zxing/browser to package.json, so on a clean install the bundle couldn't resolve @zxing/library and the entire frontend failed to compile. Always add explicit peerDependency entries to package.json when integrating ZXing-style packages. (Tester resolved by `yarn add @zxing/library@^0.22.0 --ignore-engines`.)

Minor: import('@zxing/browser') is dynamic — good for bundle-size, but the failure mode (network/CDN error) currently shows the generic 'Camera not available' toast instead of a specific 'Failed to load scanner library' message. Acceptable for MVP.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE of the compile-blocker fixed by tester: @zxing/browser@0.2.0 declares `peerDependencies: { '@zxing/library': '^0.22.0' }` (no `dependencies` field). When package.json adds only @zxing/browser, yarn does NOT auto-install peer deps, so the bundle fails with 8 'Module not found: @zxing/library' webpack errors in node_modules/@zxing/browser/esm/**/*.js. REPRODUCTION: (a) fresh `yarn install` on a checkout that only has @zxing/browser → compile fails; (b) visit /donate/shipment/{token} → 'Compiled with problems' overlay covers the entire UI; PIN input is unreachable. MITIGATION applied: `cd /app/frontend && yarn add @zxing/library@^0.22.0 --ignore-engines` then `supervisorctl restart frontend`. Result: webpack compiles clean (40 unrelated warnings, 0 errors), donor page renders, ZXing scanner instantiates correctly inside the dialog. NOTE for main agent: keep @zxing/library in package.json `dependencies` explicitly so future fresh-installs don't regress.
